scripts.setup: npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
scripts.deploy: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote && wrangler deploy
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test

ACCESS_TEAM_DOMAIN.description: Your Cloudflare Access team domain, e.g. `yourteam.cloudflareaccess.com` (Zero Trust → Settings → Custom Pages). Leave empty for now: the notebook shows a setup page until Access is configured. See the [README](https://github.com/evankrob/seo-notebook#after-you-deploy).

ACCESS_AUD.description: The **Application Audience (AUD) Tag** of the Access application that protects this Worker (Zero Trust → Access → Applications → your app). Leave empty until you have created it.

GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT.description: Optional secret: a Google service-account JSON key with read access to your Search Console and GA4 properties. Add it later with `npx wrangler secret put GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT < service-account.json`. See [Connect Google data](https://github.com/evankrob/seo-notebook#connect-google-data).
